In [[mathematics]], the '''y-homeomorphism''', or '''crosscap slide''', is a special type of auto-[[homeomorphism]] in [[orientability|non-orientable]] [[Surface (topology)|surface]]s.

It can be constructed by sliding a [[Möbius strip]] included on the surface 
around an essential [[2-sided|1-sided]] [[closed curve]] until the original position; thus it is necessary that the surfaces have [[genus (mathematics)|genus]] greater than one. The projective plane <math>{\mathbb RP}^2</math> has no y-homeomorphism.
